_doc: Held-out set (EVALS §3): 8 descriptions for agentic, RAG and multimodal surfaces. Text and ground-truth traits copied verbatim from build/atlas/EVALS.md §3 (planner draft, checked by the plan reviewer). needs_agent_security from EVALS §9.1 (planner draft: yes for H1, H3, H6, H8). Not shown to makers, not used in tests or fixtures; run once at INT.

descriptions.text: Build an email triage agent that reads incoming support emails, looks up the customer in our CRM, and drafts and sends replies using Claude.
Add an internal knowledge assistant that answers employee questions from our Confluence and Google Drive documents using retrieval augmented generation.
Create a coding agent that opens pull requests, runs shell commands in CI and can merge its own changes.
We want a public API that summarizes uploaded contracts with GPT-4o and stores the summaries for our legal team.
Fine-tune an open-source model downloaded from Hugging Face on our support tickets and deploy it behind our helpdesk widget.
Build a research assistant with long-term memory that browses the web, saves notes, and calls tools through MCP servers.
A pipeline where one LLM extracts invoice fields from scanned images and a second LLM decides whether to approve payment.
Add a voice-enabled shopping assistant for our mobile app that recommends products and places orders for the user.
